top_findings.title: SDK-based MCP server (mcp_server.py) is non-functional dead code
top_findings.evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/mcp_server.py:11 `import mcp.server.stdio` raises ImportError: cannot import name 'TypeAdapter' from 'pydantic' (pydantic v1 in-env, mcp needs v2); line 589 `default_server = BrazilianSoccerMCPServer()` at import time; 19 `@self.server.call_tool()` decorators (lines 53-324) all register the SDK's single global call_tool handler so only the last survives; `list_tools` appears 0 times so get_tools() (line 342) is never wired to a list_tools handler; .coverage shows mcp_server.py line_bits=0 (0% coverage, never imported by tests).
top_findings.suggestion: Pin pydantic>=2, register one @server.list_tools() returning get_tools() and one @server.call_tool() that dispatches by name, and add an import/smoke test. R1 is still satisfied by server.py, but this module ships broken.

requirement_coverage_note: Second-opinion re-score over pinned REQUIREMENTS.json: 12/12 implemented. First evaluation scored 0.9167 marking R1 unmet; R1 is satisfied by server.py (tested 19-handler dispatcher) plus mcp_server.py's SDK tool definitions. The broken SDK transport is recorded as finding R1-sdk (high), not a missing requirement.
